notes.title: July 31, 2021, the official version was released
notes.notes:
As you read this, Falsemen2: Upstream has moved from early access to official release.

Thank you very much for your love and support. In the four and a half years from early February 2017 to the end of July 2021, I have finally finished the game I wanted to make, and all kinds of optimization and content filling for the game have been completed.

After four and a half years of production, I was happy that I was finally able to make the niche product THAT I wanted to make, regardless of the market. But at the same time I was too tired, too tired to do any publicity for the finished game, even though it was my job as a producer to do it.

If I had to say a word to describe my current state, it would be "lying flat".

I had done what I wanted to do, and I didn't really care how many sales the game made, I liked it, you liked it, you liked it.

I am a novel writer, a speaker, a b-station master, an outsourcing programmer, an amateur designer, a daily cook, a food blogger who wants to eat all over the world...

On top of that, I'm a game producer.

While I've spent a lot of time with you as a game producer, making games has always been just one of my hobbies.

I'm a hobby driven bad guy. I only do what I love to do -- it's like I don't like to work, so I've never worked a single day since I graduated from college and I've been freelancing ever since.

I mean, there's a lot of things I like to do.

In the future, I will do every one of them.



With Falsemen2: Upstream finished, what's next?

I think my fans who follow me have already guessed that, yes, it's TokyoStranger.

I've never made a horror game, but I do want to -- it's also an interest-driven thing, I want to make something I've never done before.

Because I'm afraid of both ghosts and the dark, and I haven't seen more than 10 horror movies, making TokyoStranger was an exciting challenge for me.

I'm looking forward to the final product, and hopefully this time I can make a game that I like as well.



On top of that, I hope I can reach 200,000 fans this year and make lasting Nightware videos, whether it's the slightly better PlayerSleuth or the more recent attempt with Nightware Speak.

Keep loving, keep confident, keep fighting, and time will do the rest.

Let's cheer together.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35499645/3e5cbef30b463db7c3e744540695fcece2c6ec57.png


This update to Falsemen2: Upstream includes:

1. A new branch story, An Ordinary Day of The Imperial Security Guard, will be added to the uptown of Wanghai City. It will be presented to hardcore fans who have found nearly 100 bugs in the closed beta versions of Upstream in the first two years of development;



2. Added a secondary storyline, Theoretical Knowledge Across History, to the Cliff Library of King Andrexius, for hardcore fans mooncakes and Arabidopsis_W who have found hundreds of bugs in Upstream's Beta over the past year and a half;



3. Modify the click logic of the character selection interface. The player can select the corresponding character when the mouse hover over the corresponding character, and the second confirmation will be entered after clicking.



4. Modify the return logic of difficulty selection interface and character selection interface. You can return to the upper interface in these two interfaces.



5. Changed the text presentation logic in the temporary shelter system. Text in the temporary shelter is now automatically displayed.



6. Proofread and corrected 15 text errors and omissions.

notes.title: After 7 months, I came to you with 10000 words of update log
notes.notes:
Long time no see, I`m Yesenmidnight, the developer of Falsemen2: Upstream.
After 7 months, the original version of fallemen2: upstream (version 0.36) on steam will be fully upgraded to fallemen2: upstream Spring Festival Version (version 0.72).

At the same time, it also represents that my game development has entered a new stage. In four years, from February 2017 to February 2021, I finally completed 72% of the game content.

I hope you like my development and creation, and thank you for your company. In the future, I will go further with you.

Now please allow me to briefly share with you what is different from the original version of the game after this update.

The first part: playing mechanism:

1. After the game is updated, 310 open maps in the original version of the game will be disabled in gale version, and only the old version can be saved to enter the disabled 310 maps; at the same time, 68 copies of open world will be opened in the new version for players to explore freely in the countercurrent world. If you want to keep the original countercurrent game data, please backup the original archive in advance, or go directly to the installation directory to backup the original game package.

2. The Spring Festival edition of countercurrent has a complete open world, including 6 regional maps (Jedi Island, sound, Yanlin, Lianmian mountains, Wanghai City, Xuri Wangdu), and each region has 9-15 regional copies, a total of 68 copies of the open world. The content and difficulty of each copy are different. After the game starts, players can go to any area at the first time to explore the copies. The system does not set access restrictions for copies.

3. Open area: desperate island.

Jedi island is located at the southwest end of the Andre Empire, in the extreme west of the South boundless sea.

The regional map group of Jedi island has 12 regional copies, including: Exile Town, barge management office, upside down tower, stranded transport ship, misty forest, Junzhen ruins, mirage forest, abandoned village, twilight swamp, lucky beach, poisonous swamp and nameless pastoral area. Players can explore freely in 12 regional dungeons, each with unique enemies, items, regional merchants, synthesizers, genesis fragments, and other game content to explore.

4. Open area: sound.

Located in the easternmost part of Andre Empire, sander is a neutral autonomous region composed of desert basin and low hills.

Sound regional map group has 14 regional copies, including: Lvyin Town, Fengshou temple, desert sea, ronghuo forest land, xiaoqunshan, Qiyu mountain, Wangshan Gobi, Kuhe forest land, relic mines, ancient statues, fengsha Gobi, boat tombs, sheltered hills and Shuangshen lake. Players can explore freely in 14 regional dungeons, each with unique enemies, items, regional merchants, synthesizers, genesis fragments, and other game content to explore.

5. Open area: smoke forest.

Smoke forest is located in the south of the old world of Andrey empire. It used to be the capital of the elves. After the elves died out, it was ruled by the Empire. At present, it is co governed by two imperial forces: "Duke of Saxon house" and "Franklin College".

The map group has 14 regional copies, including: ancient tree forest, Duke's house, Franklin college, city alliance, solidarity department, Queens, lower city, Gulfstream arena, prosperity harbor, maritime gathering, hunting woodland, burning woodland, fraternity department, sinner's arena. Players can explore freely in 14 regional dungeons, each with unique enemies, items, regional merchants, synthesizers, genesis fragments, and other game content to explore.

6. Open area: continuous mountains.

Located in the northwest of the new world of Andre Empire, the continuous mountains formed a natural barrier between the Empire and the forces of marginal cities, and were also the birthplace of endless legends and secrets.

The map group of Lianmian mountains region has 9 regional copies, including: Moonlight River, North rose mountain, barren mountain grassland, highland forest, miasma Valley, Yongdong mountain, long night corridor, dawn temple, three thousand mile Jedi, and the top of snow mountain. Players can explore freely in 9 regional replicas, each with unique enemies, items, regional merchants, synthesizers, genesis fragments, and other game content to explore.

7. Open area: Wanghai city.

Wanghai city is located in the north of the new world of Andre empire. It used to be the capital of the Gao empire. Now Wanghai city is governed and managed by Franklin college. It is the political and military center of the new world of the Empire.

Wanghaicheng regional map group has 9 regional copies, including: Haiya fort, Huanan mountain, Shangcheng District, Huanan Museum, Haiya arena, noon gate, main urban district, sun never setting port and homing lighthouse. Players can explore freely in 9 regional replicas, each with unique enemies, items, regional merchants, synthesizers, genesis fragments, and other game content to explore.

8. Open area: Xuri Wangdu.

Sun King is located in the north of the old world of Andrew Empire, which has been the capital of Andrew empire for more than 600 years.

The regional map of Xuri Wangdu has 10 regional copies, including: Kaixuan square, Shengui square, never falling City, pilgrimage ladder, Tiewei fortress, new army fortress, glow corridor, cliff library, nameless cliff and sustainable core. Players can explore freely in 10 regional replicas, each of which has unique enemies, items, regional merchants, synthesizers, genesis fragments, and other game content to explore.

9. In the game, all regional replicas are free to explore. Most of the replicas have one explorable replica content, but a small number of replicas are composed of multiple explorable content. A composite copy with multiple explorable copies is usually displayed as a large icon on the map, and a composite level prompt mark is hung on the left side of the icon.

There are 16 composite copies in the countercurrent world, including: inverted tower (3), Lvyin town (3), desert sea (2), ancient tree forest (7), Franklin College (4), Duke's Mansion (4), Huanan mountain (6), Shangcheng district (4), Haiya Castle (5), never falling city (6), long night corridor (3), Shuangsheng Lake (2), Tuanjie Department (2), and three thousand li Jue The earth (2), the top of snow mountain (2), the nameless Cliff (3), the eternal core (4).

The number in brackets is the number of independent copies owned by the combined copy.

10. Updated the replica map that you can explore freely. In each independent replica, players will encounter 15 random adventure pages and 1 guard elite enemy. Players are free to choose actions on each adventure page, and flexibly deal with the guard elite to get through the current copy.

On the ordinary adventure page, players will have three optional adventure contents, including enemy events, collection events and treasure chest related to replica environment; on the adventure page 4 / 9 / 15, players will have four optional adventure contents, including regional merchants, value-added merchants, on-board treasure chest, equipment synthesis platform, cooking synthesis platform, skill inspiration and creation fragments.

11. 17 different equipment synthesis platforms are installed. Through the equipment synthesis platform, players can synthesize a total of 82 common weapons and armor.

12. 13 different cooking synthesis tables are installed, through which players can synthesize a total of 75 usable props and dishes.

13. 6 kinds of collection items and 18 kinds of collection events were updated, including 3 kinds of felling, 3 kinds of mining, 3 kinds of fishing, 3 kinds of exploration, 3 kinds of hunting and 3 kinds of picking; 4 kinds of map treasure boxes were updated, including ordinary treasure boxes, solid treasure boxes, simple treasure boxes and weird treasure boxes, and the contents of each treasure box were different from the original.

14. The skill acquisition method of skill inspiration has been updated. At present, the acquisition of skill inspiration is related to the appearance of the characters. There are 32 different appearance equipment in the game. At present, all of them can be acquired in the game, and each appearance has a different skill pool of inspiration.

15. There are 24 kinds of merchants in different regions. Each merchant appears in different regional maps, with different goods reserves, different discount ranges, and special purchases that will be bought back at high prices.

16. There are 28 different value-added merchants, each of which appears in different independent copies, selling different special props and growth props. Every time the value-added merchants buy, the price of the corresponding props will increase.

17. 36 pieces of Genesis scrolls were added and actually loaded, which were distributed among the maps of various regions and independent copies. Each creation scroll has unique powers. They will bring your character some unique fighting skills, which will be forgotten as the character dies.

18. 64 different combat techniques have been added and installed.

19. The "team fighting" system is installed and opened. When the player has more than one team member, the system will automatically switch the in-game fighting mode to team mode. In the team mode, all the characters of both sides will act in each round, and the order of action will be in accordance with the order shown in the "queue". The agility of characters affects the order of action.

20. The "single fight" system is updated and installed. When the number of players is 1, the system will automatically switch the battle mode in the game to single fight mode. In the single challenge mode, only two characters on the field can take action in each round, and the action order of both sides is determined by both sides' agility and skill speed.

21. The "arena" system has been installed and opened. In the fairyland forest, Gulfstream arena, Haiya arena and sinner arena, even if the player has more than one player, the combat mode will also adopt the single challenge mode. In the case of multi player single challenge, only two players on the field can act in each round, but the players can be switched quickly by switching the form of players.

22. The "chieftain's Guide" system is installed and opened. All the chieftain's enemies encountered in the players' exploration of the open world will stand in the challenge interface of the story camp. Players can challenge all the unlocked leader enemies. If they succeed in the challenge, they will get special rewards. "

23. The new exploration and stability system has been updated and installed. When the player's exploration degree in the open world is increased to 100 / 200 / 400, he will get the reward of exploration degree; when the player's stability degree in the open world is reduced to 0 / - 100 / - 200, he will get the reward of stability degree. Exploration and stability will be reset to 0 and 100 each time the player goes from the area map to the world map.

24. The new mobility system has been updated and installed. The player initially has 30 points of mobility. Every time he enters the exploration map, he will consume 1 point of mobility. When the player's mobility is exhausted, he will be forced to return to the world map and reset exploration and stability.

25. The original design of automatically assigning two different protagonist teams by tossing a coin was deleted, and it was modified to choose one of the seven standby protagonists as the first protagonist of the game through the role preparation room before the game started. Players will control the characters they choose to enter the game, and assign potential teammates who may be accepted according to the characters they choose. If the selected role belongs to the "carriage tea party" team, you can accept Vincent, drexley, Harry Finch and Lorraine as teammates in the game; if the selected role belongs to the "misty islanders" team, you can accept them as teammates in the game.

26. Update and install the new difficulty system:

In normal mode, the damage data of the enemy and our side are all standard values. Every time the player leaves from the independent copy to go to the area map, all the dead players will revive and recover all their life and magic.

In difficult mode, the damage value of both sides is 120% of the standard value. Every time a player leaves from an independent copy to go to the area map, all the dead players will be revived to 1 point of health. Life and magic are not added.

In hell mode, the damage value of both sides is 150% of the standard value. Players can't open the backpack to use and save the props in the dungeon. Every time they leave from the independent dungeon, all players will not return blood, will not revive, and will not add magic.

27. A new wish system has been added and installed. Before the game starts, players need to choose the wish goal they want to complete in this round of the game, and the completion of the wish is regarded as the victory of the game. There are 24 wishes in the current version, including 12 d-level wishes and 12 C-level wishes.

The second part: task plot

28. Add and implement 12 d-level wish tasks.

 First step out of oblivion: go to desperate island to help the forgotten repair the transport ship.

 Wanted celebrity: find and defeat a legend.

 Poison scholar: in an adventure, he hoards 50 bottles of poison and fierce poison bottles.

 Life scholar: in an adventure, he hoarded 50 bottles of all kinds of life recovery potions.

 Desert yearns for a rain: go to sander area to help desert residents complete the harvest ceremony of harvest temple.

 Return of the classical age: go to the smoke forest to help the elves finish the return ceremony of the ancient tree forest.

 Three stakes in a fence: find and recruit two different teammates.

 Between truth and falsehood: go to desperate island and look out at the sea at Lucky beach for 15 days in a row.

 Discover business opportunities: go to the sound area and earn 50000 gold coins through ore trading.

 Bright: find and get 2 different fashions.

 Nurturing lovers: find and obtain 10 character growth treasure boxes.

 Qualified Explorer: go to any map and increase the current map exploration to 100%.

29. Add and implement 12 level C wish tasks.

 Forest Explorer: discover and explore six different forests around the world.

 Glamorous: find and get 5 different fashions.

 Treasure box collector: find and obtain 20 character growth treasure boxes.

 Celebrity wanted expert: find and defeat three legendary characters.

 "Falman's Susheng": find and obtain legendary equipment: falman's Susheng.

 Eternal of wintus: finding and acquiring legendary equipment: Eternal of wintus.

 Leviathan's will: finding and acquiring legendary equipment: Leviathan's will.

 Sindor's mask: finding and acquiring legendary equipment: sindor's mask.

 "The hairpin of finch": find and obtain the legendary equipment: finch's hairpin. (Queens)

 Leonard's hand binding: finding and acquiring legendary equipment: Leonard's hand binding.

 Word of mouth of the night God: find and obtain legendary equipment: word of mouth of the night God.

 Explorer of the Kingdom: find any chapter in genesis, 12 pages in total.

30. The guidance system in the open world map has been added and installed. Players can see the area of teammates, anecdotes, legends and the desired target of this round of the game on the open map.

31. The main plot in the game is disabled in the current version, and the main plot will be updated in the future version.

32. Five new stories are added, which are "the ship of freedom - the first step out of Oblivion", "cult - Desert yearning for a rain", "gentleman loves money - Desert miner", "fairy mother tree - return of the classical era", "wind up machine - between truth and falsehood";

33. Seven new stories of legend branch line are added, which are "old day Reappearance - finch's hairpin", "old day Reappearance - reinard's hand binding", "old day Reappearance - Leviathan's will", "old day Reappearance - Hindo's mask", "old day Reappearance - the eternity of wintus", "historical correction company - Salman's Susheng" and "egg Legend - the altar of the night God".

34. Add 7 new characters to join the team.

35. Add 12 episodes of historical delivery.

The third part: combat system class

36. The new version of combat is divided into three modes: "team mode", "multi player single challenge" and "single player single challenge". The three modes will automatically switch with the current player's exploration and team situation.

In the team mode, the teams of both sides can cooperate quickly. In each round of battle, all the characters will take action and move in turn according to the order shown in the queue;

In the multi player single challenge, it is more difficult for both sides to cooperate with each other, but we can achieve tactical rescue by cutting the players quickly;

In single player challenge, enemy characters will only have characters in the same battle plane with you to take action each round.

37. A new "retreat skill" has been updated and installed. The default success rate of retreat skill is currently 80%, but it is affected by the hit rate and speed of skill casting.

38. Updated and implemented the "speed correction" instructions for each skill. Speed correction only affects multi player single challenge and single player single challenge, but does not affect team combat. In a single fight, the skill speed correction will be combined with the character's basic agility attribute to judge the hand order of the enemy and us in the current round.

39. Four different turn modes have been updated and installed. Players can choose auto fight, 6 second Blitzkrieg, 12 second regular season and infinite time turn in the settings. In different turn modes, players have different thinking time in each turn.

40. Add and actually install the "battle position" system. In the team combat mode, no matter how many roles the enemy and us have, in the same combat phase, the target of casting the enemy's single skill is only the enemy's role currently displayed in the combat position. For example, if the queue order of [our a] [our b] [enemy C] [enemy D] is A1, B2, C3, D4, then in the case of no special circumstances, the target of C and D's single attack skill is B, and the target of a and B's single attack skill is d.

Such a system will derive a variety of playing methods. For example, by stun the enemy d to skip the stage of D, a and B can attack C through single skill. For example, through the teammates with the feature of "protecting the weak", when the residual blood teammates are about to be attacked, they can actively replace the combat position instead of being attacked.

41. A combat data backtracking system has been added and installed. In combat, players can view the action, hit and damage of both sides in each round of the current battle through the "information" button.

42. The queue system in team combat has been added and installed. In team combat, players can check the order of all the roles in the current battle through the "queue" button, so as to formulate corresponding action strategies.

The forth part: game data

43. New and real props: chicken legs, wood, floating wood, hard drink, three square crystal, nine square crystal.

44. Update and install the achievement equipment in the game: wanted celebrity [1 ~ 9], church celebrity [1 ~ 3], swamp fitness [1 ~ 3], fishing talent [1 ~ 3], entomologist [1 ~ 3], ancient scholar [1 ~ 3], highly toxic school [1 ~ 5], life school [1 ~ 3], magic school [1 ~ 3], old system light [1 ~ 5], new army close friend [1 ~ 3].

45. Delete achievement equipment: night God's plain life, night God's dream gift, night God's life to death, performing arts, and great magician.

46. 64 kinds of combat skills of Genesis are added and installed.

47. The "Franklin academy" and its 15 new enemies and 25 new enemy groups that can explore and fight were updated and installed, including the new army gunners, senior gunners, artillery squads, war machines and chief enemy Carles Franklin of different levels and behavior patterns.

48. The "rebirth of the demon king" and its 33 new and old enemies, 48 new and old enemy groups that can explore and fight are updated and installed, including slave swordsman, slave scholar, slave mage, shriveled officer, shriveled giant fish, shriveled mage, suona mosquito, Gong monkey, drum rabbit of different levels and behavior patterns, and leader enemy Anne LeBron , Rochi, ray Jean.

49. The AI logic behind the power "Duke house" and its 53 kinds of enemies and 43 kinds of enemies that can explore and fight is updated and optimized, including swordsmen, assassins, shield guards, muskets, Rangers, knights, guards, sergeants, magistrates, mages, weird mirrors, cell doors, giant doors of different levels and behavior patterns, and chief enemy winter Saxon.

50. The hidden leader enemy queen of the north, Quinn Sartre, has been added and installed.

51. The AI logic of 13 leader enemies and their dynamic levels when they appear in the challenge interface are updated and optimized, including misty Islander replica, carriage tea party replica, Carls Franklin, cyron Andre, Rolando, Monica Monroe Alice, didos, Griffin Newell, King shrem, ray Jean and noble truth, Anne and false joy Drama, Roche and the dark fortress, Queen of the North Quinn Sartre.

52. Add 175 kinds of formula table that can be synthesized.

The fifth part: Game optimization

53. The animation of some skills has been modified to make the combat system more fluent.

54. The damage calculation method and map refresh method of combat system are modified, so that the maps of both sides can be updated normally with the refresh of damage stage.

55. Modify the keyboard adaptation system of the game, so that the WASD keys can control the character movement instead of the up and down keys.

56. Modify the keyboard adaptation system of the game, so that all the UI can be controlled by up, down, left, right and space bar.

57. The mouse control rules in the combat phase have been modified to prevent players from touching the mouse wheel by mistake.

58. Optimize the underlying animation rendering algorithm, so that the game does not appear occasional picture static bug.

59. Optimize the image refresh logic of the store system, so that the store no longer has wrong discount map and empty map.

60. Optimize the keyboard adaptation of the store system, so that the store system can switch the interface through shortcut keys.

61. The screen design of the game has been modified, and the default setting when players enter the game has been changed to full screen.

62. The original logo design of the production group was modified to make the logo more concise and aesthetic.

63. Changed the coin toss process from silver and iron coins to imperial gold coins.

64. Modify the background image of the start menu after entering the game.

65. The original 40 old style gold background pictures were deleted, and 125 more atmosphere scene background pictures were modified and added. The artistic style of the background picture is changed from solid color to warm color.

66. 304 copies of map enemy cards and 36 copies of map non combat interactive cards were designed and installed.

67. Designed, produced and installed a new player control character icon.

68. 83 regional map exploration location icons and 6 kinds of guide icons were designed and installed.

69. Designed, produced and installed 8 kinds of non combat interactive event animations.

70. Designed, produced and installed 7 protagonists in the introduction stage to show the indoor display screen.

71. Redesigned and implemented the full UI of exploration map.

72. Many other bugs have been fixed, and many other designs have been made.

The above is the whole content of this update.
